content:
An approved unexecuted request remains executable if its terms are still the requested operation and its approver remains active at the recorded epoch. A second identical proposal is not required for that unchanged approval.

Revocation invalidates older approvals even if a request still displays APPROVED. Retrying an already executed request returns the saved receipt without paying again; creating a new proposal with similar terms creates a separate operation.

title: Existing approvals and idempotent execution
